fieldData.main-content:
‍The Consultation is live now and closes at 23:59 on Jan 13th 2026. Have your say in the Season 1 conclusion date and unlocking schedule.

Following the informal feedback gathered recently regarding the conclusion of Radix Rewards Season 1, we are moving to a formal consultation to finalize the parameters. This consultation allows the community to input on the end date for the season and define the liquidity vesting curve for the distributed rewards.

To ensure the decision reflects the broad consensus of the network rather than a polarized outcome, this consultation will not use a simple majority ("winner-takes-all") count.

Instead, the results for both questions will be calculated using a weighted average, rounded to the closest available option. This approach captures the aggregate preference of all voters.

The Proposals

The consultation asks two key questions based on the options surfaced during the feedback period.

1. When should Radix Rewards Season 1 end? We need to establish the specific cutoff date for Season 1 activity. Options:

  • January 24th, 2026
  • Extend to February 22nd, 2026
  • Extend to March 29th, 2026

‍

2. What is the vesting timeframe for rewards? At the end of Season 1, rewards will be distributed as liquid vesting units that unlock over time. While you can redeem early (forfeiting unvested tokens to the pool), the "maturity" period defines the full unlock schedule. Options: 

  • 1 week 
  • 1 month
  • 2 months
  • 3 months
  • 4 months
  • 5 months
  • 6 months.

‍

Timeline and Next Steps

This consultation is open NOW and closes at 23:59 UTC on January 13, 2026. As with past consultations, connect your Radix wallet and link desired accounts. Your vote will be token weighted based on XRD/LSUs held in linked accounts.

Share your opinion here: https://consultation.radixdlt.com/dashboard/consultations

‍
fieldData.name: Token Holder Consultation: Season 1 Timeline & Vesting Mechanics
